price_note: Home of the grilled chicken wings, in their own words: Mr. Carlyle's family recipe, grilled for ten years before he opened in August 2025. Prices are from the online ordering for their Oakland shop in Jack London
flags: Read by the main session from their own Shopify site (Locations, About us, Pick-up, Contact, /products.json) and the Oakland shop's own Clover ordering page, which the site's Pick-up page links; the research agent stalled.

Locations, from their own Locations page: the Oakland Storefront, 439 Water St, Oakland 94607, Tue-Sun 11:30am-8pm, closed Mondays, 'or until sold-out'; the Tracy Storefront, 549 W Clover Rd; and two farmers markets, Downtown Tracy (Sat 8am-1pm) and Jack London Square (Webster St & Embarcadero West, Sun 11am-4pm). The page is the Oakland shop's.
Prices: Oakland's own Clover ordering, which runs about 3.6% above the Tracy shop's and the Shopify store's (10 wings $14.50 in Oakland, $13.99 in Tracy, $14.99 on Shopify). Oakland's are used.
Flavors from their own product descriptions: Cajun, BBQ Sweet and Louisiana Hot Honey. @booziebrunch's reel also names a hot honey and BBQ combination.
Tracy's hours differ between their Locations page (Fri-Sat to 10pm) and About us (Fri-Sat to 11pm); not this page's shop.
Their Menu link goes to a DoorDash store named Emeryville; not used.
Owner: Jamale Carlyle (Instagram name); their site calls him Mr. Carlyle.
On review: seated at oakland-goods2-15 (yellow sheet: Oakland's Chicken wings is Lucky Three Seven's), with the whole page for @booziebrunch's reel. Glenn's message of 28 September, 1:14 pm.
